provenance: Shape of the JSON Claude Code 2.1.287 pipes to a statusLine command, read from the shipped binary's builder on 2026-10-01: the base hook input (session_id, transcript_path, cwd, permission_mode, agent_type) spread first, then model / workspace {current_dir, project_dir, added_dirs} / version / output_style / cost / context_window. cwd and workspace.current_dir are the SAME value (the session's current directory, which follows cd); project_dir is the directory the window was opened in. Path fields are blank here and filled per test with temp dirs; the session id is a made-up UUID.
